results.title: Best practice guidelines for peer review - Editor Resources
results.content: It is more vital than ever, for academic journal editors to follow **peer review best practice** when assessing original research for publication. To avoid the possibility of bias compromising the decision-making process, it is important to get reports from **two independent peer reviewers** for every published research article. ## Can an editor act as an independent peer reviewer? * When following peer review best practice, **a manuscript’s handling editor should not act as an independent peer reviewer**. ## Can an editor desk reject a paper without independent peer reviewer feedback? If an author isn’t happy with the way their paper was handled or appeals the decision, having two independent peer reviews demonstrates the paper was handled by you appropriately, in-line with policy and following best practice. ### Can I act as an independent peer reviewer on a paper I am handling? A paper’s handling editor should not act as an independent peer reviewer. ### Can a guest editor act as an independent peer reviewer on a research article they are handling?
